headline: Trump 🍊👑 threatens $1.8B 💸 'Anti-Weaponization' Fund 🔫💥 as Senate GOP Cucks 😩🤡 hold out on Blanche 👨‍⚖️🔥
text:
Trump 🍊🍔 just dropped the ULTIMATE 🔥💣 THREAT on Truth Social 🗣️📱: if those two RINO senators 🐘💔 Cornyn 🌽🥜 and Tillis 🍞🧀 don't confirm his ride-or-die attorney general pick Todd Blanche 👨‍⚖️🤝, then the $1.8 BILLION 💸💸 'Anti-Weaponization' fund will RISE FROM THE DEAD 🧟‍♂️🪦 like a political zombie! The Big Orange 🍊 has spoken and it's giving MAJOR revenge tour vibes 🎭💅

This fund was originally supposed to be Trump's IRS lawsuit settlement money 💰⚖️ that would pay his allies for 'politically motivated prosecutions' 🏛️😤 - basically a billionaire's revenge fund that had everyone SHOOK 😱💦! Democrats were screaming bloody murder 🩸📢 and even some Republicans were like 'no thank you' 🙅‍♂️ when they realized it could compensate January 6th rioters who went full WWE on cops 👮‍♂️🥊

Blanche (Trump's former personal lawyer turned acting AG) 🕴️👔 originally negotiated this whole mess but had to YEET 🗑️💨 the plan after the backlash went nuclear ☢️🔥. A federal judge also BLOCKED IT like it was a bad Tinder date 🚫💔, saying it violated ethics codes 📜🤢

But now Cornyn and Tillis - whose terms expire in January ⏰❄️ - are holding Blanche's confirmation HOSTAGE 🪤🔒 unless he promises in writing ✍️📝 that the fund won't come back like a bad sequel movie 🎬😩. Trump straight up called them out saying they're 'upset because I wouldn't endorse them' 😤🤡

Tillis clapped back on X saying Trump is trying to 'resurrect the payout pot for punks' 🧛‍♂️💰 and that Blanche won't get confirmed because of this drama 🎭💥. The Senate Judiciary Committee is supposed to vote on Tuesday 🗳️📅 and this whole situation is giving MAJOR political soap opera energy 📺🍿

Even as lame duck lawmakers 🦆💀 these two senators are still throwing SHADE at Trump's agenda like they're the final bosses in a video game 🎮👾. Trump's trying to make it rain 💸🌧️ for his allies while Cornyn and Tillis are like 'not on our watch' 🚫👀 - it's the ultimate political standoff 🤠⚔️!
